title: Two revisions of a drawing in one NPP delivery: when splitting by numbers is lawful
description: Decision I-7 introduces revision B from number 005 and retains A for 001–004. The filled statement of the mixed delivery and a separate outcome for 009, erroneously made to A.
seo_title: Mixed drawing revisions: transition boundary by instances
seo_description: 001–004 to A, 005–008 to B: when two versions in one machine are not an error. A ready answer for acceptance and analysis of the additional number 009.
seo_keywords: mixed drawing revisions NPP, transition to new revision by number, set of documentation for item execution, two drawing versions delivery
content:
Two revisions of a drawing in one shipment do not necessarily mean an error. If a proper transition decision permits the previous execution for certain numbers, the set must preserve exactly this division. Assigning the latest revision to all items for the sake of a single folder would distort their history. Below is a conditional delivery where a mixed composition is permissible under the accepted condition, but single documentation for all eight instances creates a false correspondence.

Revision B is introduced from number 005

The manufacturer produces eight U-16 units numbered 001–008. Before the change, drawing Ch-16 revision A is applied. Properly executed decision I-7 sets the transition: revision B is introduced starting from 005; instances 001–004 retain the prescribed execution A. In the educational example, the authority, applicability of the decision and the necessary grounds for the transition are considered verified.

For actual 001–004, the execution and related records correspond to A. For 005–008 — to B. Both sets are shipped by one machine. The packer sees the common order number and includes only Ch-16 B in the eight passport folders with the wording "manufactured to the current revision". The receiver notices the difference of the first four and demands the whole delivery be reworked to B.

Both actions ignore I-7. In our case, the first four are not obliged to become B merely because of the common shipment date. But they cannot be described as manufactured to B. The correct result is to preserve the permitted difference and issue the relevant information to each instance. One waybill does not create a single design execution. The link to the number must be preserved on the packaging as well; otherwise the correct distribution in the register will not help issue the required set to the installer.

Filled separation statement

InstancesRequired basis in the exampleActual stateTransfer set
001–004I-7 retains ACorresponds to A per verified informationLink to A and I-7, related results
005–008I-7 introduces B from 005Corresponds to B per verified informationLink to B and I-7, related results

The table is not a new permission for two versions. It discloses an already established decision. If I-7 does not exist or does not relate to this order, the positive conclusion disappears. From the date of first manufacture, the manager's words or the presence of two drawing files, the right to a mixed delivery cannot be derived independently.

How to answer the demand to replace everything with B

Shipment U-16 contains 001–008. I-7 introduces Ch-16 B from 005 and retains A for 001–004. Actual executions and records have been compared with the stated boundary; the distribution is attached. We ask that the first four be considered on the basis A provided for them, and the next four on B. The single reference to B in the prepared folders is subject to proper clarification; it does not reflect the actual composition. We ask that the date of a single shipment not be regarded as an independent ground for changing the permitted boundary.

Such an answer must be accompanied by I-7 itself and the related materials. If only the manufacturer's table has been handed to the recipient, he is entitled not to see the basis of its conclusion. Eliminating a document shortage should not be confused with changing the design: sometimes the issue is closed by correctly transferring already existing results.

What to do with the additional number 009

Suppose 009, actually executed to A, was added at the last minute. Under I-7 it should already correspond to B. The fact that 001–004 are permitted to A does not extend the exception to any following part. For 009, a specific discrepancy with the applicable transitional condition is established. It must be considered in the proper order, not included in the first line of the statement for convenient packaging.

Do not change number 009 to a free early number to obtain an external match with I-7. The identifier preserves the real history. A possible further decision must relate to the actual instance and its condition, not to a new label. The other eight do not automatically turn into the same disputed case.

Check how the transition boundary is set

In the example, numbers are used. If the actual decision sets a date, a production order or a specific operation, the distribution is built on that basis. A date cannot be replaced by a number merely because numbers usually run sequentially. Each position must have a sufficient path to the established condition; otherwise a neat table will contain an unproven distribution.

Applicable requirements of nuclear assessment are checked by product and stage. NP-071-26 will come into force on 19 December 2026; as of 28 October this is a future revision. For discussing mixed executions, one may contact NPI "Nedra" with the transition decision and the actual statement of instances.
